newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Martinair ups cargo rates 5-10pct April 1.
newsitem.headline: Martinair ups cargo rates 5-10pct April 1.

text.p: Dutch carrier Martinair will increase its cargo rates worldwide, by between five and 10 percent from April 1, a spokesman said.
This rate increase follows a similar rise in December last year, when rates also increased by five to ten percent.
The Martinair spokesman said cargo rates to North America and South Africa will increase by five percent, while the Far East and South America will be subject to a rise of ten percent.
Last year, Martinair was one of the only carriers that did not enforce a fuel surcharge. Instead the Dutch carrier integrated the higher fuel costs into its cargo rates.
The spokesman said Martinair now faced higher handling costs, as well as more expensive fuel costs.
Martin is jointly-owned by KLM Royal Dutch Airlines NV and Nedlloyd. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44-171-542-7706 Fax-5017
